# Generated by tools/build_seals.py. Rulebook chapter 7, Seals.
ac_seal_craft_shard_interaction = {
	category = interaction_category_ac_seals
	common_interaction = no
	icon = secret
	desc = ac_seal_craft_shard_interaction_desc
	auto_accept = yes
	cooldown = { months = 3 }
	is_shown = {
		scope:actor = { ac_seal_craft_shard_known_trigger = yes }
		scope:recipient = scope:actor
		scope:recipient = { is_alive = yes }
	}
	is_valid_showing_failures_only = {
		scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
	}
	send_options_exclusive = no
	send_option = { flag = ac_seal_pay_shards localization = ac_seal_pay_shards_option }
	can_send = {
		custom_description = {
			text = ac_seal_cost_tt
			OR = { AND = { scope:ac_seal_pay_shards ?= yes scope:actor.short_term_gold >= { value = 100 divide = 10 ceiling = yes } } AND = { NOT = { scope:ac_seal_pay_shards ?= yes } scope:actor.ac_chi_available >= { value = 100 divide = 100 ceiling = yes min = 1 } } }
		}
	}
	on_accept = {
		scope:actor = {
			if = { limit = { scope:ac_seal_pay_shards ?= yes } remove_short_term_gold = { value = 100 divide = 10 ceiling = yes } }
			else = { save_scope_value_as = { name = ac_seal_chi value = { value = 100 divide = 100 ceiling = yes min = 1 } } ac_spend_chi_effect = { CHI = scope:ac_seal_chi } }
			ac_seal_roll_effect = yes
			save_scope_value_as = { name = ac_seal_successes value = var:ac_seal_successes }
			save_scope_value_as = { name = ac_seal_extra value = { value = var:ac_seal_successes subtract = 1 min = 0 } }
			save_scope_value_as = { name = ac_seal_ten value = { value = var:ac_seal_successes multiply = 10 } }
		}
		custom_tooltip = ac_seal_craft_shard_effect_tt
		show_as_tooltip = { scope:actor = { custom_tooltip = ac_seal_roll_tt } }
		hidden_effect = { scope:actor = { add_gold = scope:ac_seal_ten } }
		scope:actor = {
			send_interface_toast = {
				type = event_toast_effect_neutral
				title = ac_seal_craft_shard_toast
				left_icon = scope:actor
				right_icon = scope:recipient
				custom_tooltip = ac_seal_successes_tt
			}
			set_variable = { name = ac_seal_successes value = scope:ac_seal_successes days = 1 }
		}
	}
	ai_targets = { ai_recipients = self }
	ai_frequency = 12
	ai_potential = { ac_seal_craft_shard_known_trigger = yes }
	ai_will_do = { base = 20 }
}

		}
		custom_tooltip = ac_seal_reinforcement_improved_effect_tt
		show_as_tooltip = { scope:actor = { custom_tooltip = ac_seal_roll_tt } }
		hidden_effect = { scope:actor = { random_equipped_character_artifact = { limit = { artifact_slot_type = primary_armament NOT = { has_variable = ac_seal_reinforced } } add_artifact_modifier = ac_seal_reinforced_artifact_modifier set_variable = ac_seal_reinforced } add_character_modifier = { modifier = ac_seal_crowd_modifier years = 5 } } }

	cooldown = { months = 6 }
	is_shown = {
		scope:actor = { ac_seal_soulsoak_known_trigger = yes }
		scope:recipient = scope:actor
		scope:recipient = { is_alive = yes }
	}
	is_valid_showing_failures_only = {
		scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
		custom_tooltip = { text = ac_seal_needs_blade_tt scope:actor = { ac_wields_blade_trigger = yes } }
	}
	send_options_exclusive = no
	send_option = { flag = ac_seal_pay_shards localization = ac_seal_pay_shards_option }
	send_option = { flag = ac_seal_soulsoak_deep localization = ac_seal_soulsoak_deep }
	can_send = {
		custom_description = {
			text = ac_seal_cost_tt
			OR = { AND = { scope:ac_seal_pay_shards ?= yes scope:actor.short_term_gold >= { value = 200 divide = 10 ceiling = yes } } AND = { NOT = { scope:ac_seal_pay_shards ?= yes } scope:actor.ac_chi_available >= { value = 200 divide = 100 ceiling = yes min = 1 } } }
		}
	}
	on_accept = {
		scope:actor = {
			if = { limit = { scope:ac_seal_pay_shards ?= yes } remove_short_term_gold = { value = 200 divide = 10 ceiling = yes } }
			else = { save_scope_value_as = { name = ac_seal_chi value = { value = 200 divide = 100 ceiling = yes min = 1 } } ac_spend_chi_effect = { CHI = scope:ac_seal_chi } }
			ac_seal_roll_effect = yes
			save_scope_value_as = { name = ac_seal_successes value = var:ac_seal_successes }
			save_scope_value_as = { name = ac_seal_extra value = { value = var:ac_seal_successes subtract = 1 min = 0 } }
			save_scope_value_as = { name = ac_seal_ten value = { value = var:ac_seal_successes multiply = 10 } }
		}
		custom_tooltip = ac_seal_soulsoak_effect_tt
		show_as_tooltip = { scope:actor = { custom_tooltip = ac_seal_roll_tt } }
		hidden_effect = { scope:actor = { if = { limit = { scope:ac_seal_soulsoak_deep ?= yes } set_variable = { name = ac_soulsoak value = 4 months = ac_seal_m1 } } else = { set_variable = { name = ac_soulsoak value = 2 months = ac_seal_m1 } } } }
		scope:actor = {
			send_interface_toast = {
				type = event_toast_effect_neutral
				title = ac_seal_soulsoak_toast
				left_icon = scope:actor
				right_icon = scope:recipient
				custom_tooltip = ac_seal_successes_tt
			}
			set_variable = { name = ac_seal_successes value = scope:ac_seal_successes days = 1 }
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { base = 0 }
}

		}
		custom_description = { text = ac_seal_pick_skill_tt OR = { scope:ac_seal_skill_diplomacy ?= yes scope:ac_seal_skill_martial ?= yes scope:ac_seal_skill_stewardship ?= yes scope:ac_seal_skill_intrigue ?= yes scope:ac_seal_skill_learning ?= yes scope:ac_seal_skill_prowess ?= yes } }

		custom_tooltip = ac_seal_ward_effect_tt
		show_as_tooltip = { scope:actor = { custom_tooltip = ac_seal_roll_tt } }
		hidden_effect = { if = { limit = { scope:ac_seal_ward_building ?= yes scope:recipient = scope:actor } scope:actor.location.county = { add_county_modifier = { modifier = ac_seal_ward_county_modifier years = ac_seal_m1 } } } else = { scope:recipient = { add_character_modifier = { modifier = ac_seal_warded_modifier months = ac_seal_m1 } set_variable = { name = ac_seal_power value = scope:ac_seal_successes months = ac_seal_m1 } } } }
		scope:actor = {
			send_interface_toast = {
				type = event_toast_effect_neutral
				title = ac_seal_ward_toast
				left_icon = scope:actor
				right_icon = scope:recipient
				custom_tooltip = ac_seal_successes_tt
			}
			set_variable = { name = ac_seal_successes value = scope:ac_seal_successes days = 1 }
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { base = 0 }
}

ac_seal_charm_interaction = {
	category = interaction_category_ac_seals
	common_interaction = no
	icon = secret
	desc = ac_seal_charm_interaction_desc
	auto_accept = yes
	cooldown_against_recipient = { years = 1 }
	is_shown = {
		scope:actor = { ac_seal_charm_known_trigger = yes }
		NOT = { scope:recipient = scope:actor }
		scope:recipient = { is_alive = yes }
	}
	is_valid_showing_failures_only = {
		scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
	}
	send_options_exclusive = no
	send_option = { flag = ac_seal_pay_shards localization = ac_seal_pay_shards_option }
	can_send = {
		custom_description = {
			text = ac_seal_cost_tt
			OR = { AND = { scope:ac_seal_pay_shards ?= yes scope:actor.short_term_gold >= { value = 200 divide = 10 ceiling = yes } } AND = { NOT = { scope:ac_seal_pay_shards ?= yes } scope:actor.ac_chi_available >= { value = 200 divide = 100 ceiling = yes min = 1 } } }
		}
	}
	on_accept = {
		scope:actor = {
			if = { limit = { scope:ac_seal_pay_shards ?= yes } remove_short_term_gold = { value = 200 divide = 10 ceiling = yes } }
			else = { save_scope_value_as = { name = ac_seal_chi value = { value = 200 divide = 100 ceiling = yes min = 1 } } ac_spend_chi_effect = { CHI = scope:ac_seal_chi } }
			ac_seal_roll_effect = yes
			save_scope_value_as = { name = ac_seal_successes value = var:ac_seal_successes }
			save_scope_value_as = { name = ac_seal_extra value = { value = var:ac_seal_successes subtract = 1 min = 0 } }
			save_scope_value_as = { name = ac_seal_ten value = { value = var:ac_seal_successes multiply = 10 } }
		}
		custom_tooltip = ac_seal_charm_effect_tt
		show_as_tooltip = { scope:actor = { custom_tooltip = ac_seal_roll_tt } }
		hidden_effect = { scope:recipient = { ac_seal_resist_roll_effect = { SKILL = diplomacy } } if = { limit = { scope:ac_seal_successes > scope:recipient.var:ac_seal_resist } scope:recipient = { add_opinion = { target = scope:actor modifier = ac_seal_charmed_opinion } } custom_tooltip = ac_seal_charm_success_tt } else = { scope:recipient = { add_opinion = { target = scope:actor modifier = ac_seal_charm_attempt_opinion } } custom_tooltip = ac_seal_charm_failed_tt } scope:recipient = { remove_variable = ac_seal_resist } }
		scope:actor = {
			send_interface_toast = {
				type = event_toast_effect_neutral
				title = ac_seal_charm_toast
				left_icon = scope:actor
				right_icon = scope:recipient
				custom_tooltip = ac_seal_successes_tt
			}
			set_variable = { name = ac_seal_successes value = scope:ac_seal_successes days = 1 }
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { base = 0 }
}

			text = ac_seal_cost_tt
			OR = { AND = { scope:ac_seal_pay_shards ?= yes scope:actor.short_term_gold >= { value = 300 divide = 10 ceiling = yes } } AND = { NOT = { scope:ac_seal_pay_shards ?= yes } scope:actor.ac_chi_available >= { value = 300 divide = 100 ceiling = yes min = 1 } } }
		}
		custom_description = { text = ac_seal_pick_spirit_tt OR = { scope:ac_seal_spirit_earth ?= yes scope:ac_seal_spirit_water ?= yes scope:ac_seal_spirit_wisp ?= yes scope:ac_seal_spirit_kami ?= yes } }
	}
	on_accept = {
		scope:actor = {
			if = { limit = { scope:ac_seal_pay_shards ?= yes } remove_short_term_gold = { value = 300 divide = 10 ceiling = yes } }

			ac_seal_roll_effect = yes

			save_scope_value_as = { name = ac_seal_extra value = { value = var:ac_seal_successes subtract = 1 min = 0 } }
			save_scope_value_as = { name = ac_seal_ten value = { value = var:ac_seal_successes multiply = 10 } }
		}
		custom_tooltip = ac_seal_spiritbinding_effect_tt
		show_as_tooltip = { scope:actor = { custom_tooltip = ac_seal_roll_tt } }
		hidden_effect = { if = { limit = { scope:ac_seal_spirit_earth ?= yes } scope:actor.location.county = { add_county_modifier = { modifier = ac_seal_earth_spirit_county_modifier months = ac_seal_spirit_months } } } else_if = { limit = { scope:ac_seal_spirit_water ?= yes } scope:actor.location.county = { add_county_modifier = { modifier = ac_seal_water_spirit_county_modifier months = ac_seal_spirit_months } } } else_if = { limit = { scope:ac_seal_spirit_kami ?= yes NOT = { scope:recipient = scope:actor } } scope:recipient = { add_character_modifier = { modifier = ac_seal_kami_modifier months = ac_seal_spirit_months } set_variable = { name = ac_seal_power value = scope:ac_seal_successes months = ac_seal_spirit_months } } } else = { scope:recipient = { add_character_modifier = { modifier = ac_seal_wisp_modifier months = ac_seal_spirit_months } } } }
		scope:actor = {
			send_interface_toast = {
				type = event_toast_effect_neutral
				title = ac_seal_spiritbinding_toast
				left_icon = scope:actor
				right_icon = scope:recipient

		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { base = 0 }

			save_scope_value_as = { name = ac_seal_successes value = var:ac_seal_successes }
			save_scope_value_as = { name = ac_seal_extra value = { value = var:ac_seal_successes subtract = 1 min = 0 } }
			save_scope_value_as = { name = ac_seal_ten value = { value = var:ac_seal_successes multiply = 10 } }
		}
		custom_tooltip = ac_seal_thousand_face_mask_effect_tt
		show_as_tooltip = { scope:actor = { custom_tooltip = ac_seal_roll_tt } }
		hidden_effect = { scope:actor = { add_character_modifier = { modifier = ac_seal_mask_modifier months = 3 } } }
		scope:actor = {
			send_interface_toast = {
				type = event_toast_effect_neutral
				title = ac_seal_thousand_face_mask_toast
				left_icon = scope:actor
				right_icon = scope:recipient
				custom_tooltip = ac_seal_successes_tt
			}
			set_variable = { name = ac_seal_successes value = scope:ac_seal_successes days = 1 }
		}
	}
	ai_targets = { ai_recipients = self }
	ai_frequency = 12
	ai_potential = { ac_seal_thousand_face_mask_known_trigger = yes }
	ai_will_do = { base = 5 }
}

ac_seal_puppetmaster_interaction = {
	category = interaction_category_ac_seals
	common_interaction = no
	icon = secret
	desc = ac_seal_puppetmaster_interaction_desc
	auto_accept = yes
	cooldown_against_recipient = { years = 1 }
	is_shown = {
		scope:actor = { ac_seal_puppetmaster_known_trigger = yes }
		NOT = { scope:recipient = scope:actor }
		scope:recipient = { is_alive = yes }
	}
	is_valid_showing_failures_only = {
		scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
		custom_tooltip = { text = ac_seal_puppet_weak_tt OR = { scope:recipient.ac_aura_pressure_value <= { value = scope:actor.ac_aura_pressure_value multiply = 0.1 } AND = { scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned_by = scope:actor } scope:recipient.ac_aura_pressure_value <= { value = scope:actor.ac_aura_pressure_value multiply = 0.5 } } } }
	}
	send_options_exclusive = no
	send_option = { flag = ac_seal_pay_shards localization = ac_seal_pay_shards_option }
	can_send = {
		custom_description = {
			text = ac_seal_cost_tt
			OR = { AND = { scope:ac_seal_pay_shards ?= yes scope:actor.short_term_gold >= { value = { value = scope:recipient.ac_aura_pressure_value min = 100 } divide = 10 ceiling = yes } } AND = { NOT = { scope:ac_seal_pay_shards ?= yes } scope:actor.ac_chi_available >= { value = { value = scope:recipient.ac_aura_pressure_value min = 100 } divide = 100 ceiling = yes min = 1 } } }
		}
	}
	on_accept = {
		scope:actor = {
			if = { limit = { scope:ac_seal_pay_shards ?= yes } remove_short_term_gold = { value = { value = scope:recipient.ac_aura_pressure_value min = 100 } divide = 10 ceiling = yes } }
			else = { save_scope_value_as = { name = ac_seal_chi value = { value = { value = scope:recipient.ac_aura_pressure_value min = 100 } divide = 100 ceiling = yes min = 1 } } ac_spend_chi_effect = { CHI = scope:ac_seal_chi } }
			ac_seal_roll_effect = yes
			save_scope_value_as = { name = ac_seal_successes value = var:ac_seal_successes }
			save_scope_value_as = { name = ac_seal_extra value = { value = var:ac_seal_successes subtract = 1 min = 0 } }
			save_scope_value_as = { name = ac_seal_ten value = { value = var:ac_seal_successes multiply = 10 } }
		}
		custom_tooltip = ac_seal_puppetmaster_effect_tt
		show_as_tooltip = { scope:actor = { custom_tooltip = ac_seal_roll_tt } }
		hidden_effect = { if = { limit = { scope:ac_seal_successes >= 3 } if = { limit = { scope:ac_seal_successes >= 8 } scope:actor = { add_hook = { type = ac_puppet_hook_6 target = scope:recipient } } } else_if = { limit = { scope:ac_seal_successes >= 7 } scope:actor = { add_hook = { type = ac_puppet_hook_5 target = scope:recipient } } } else_if = { limit = { scope:ac_seal_successes >= 6 } scope:actor = { add_hook = { type = ac_puppet_hook_4 target = scope:recipient } } } else_if = { limit = { scope:ac_seal_successes >= 5 } scope:actor = { add_hook = { type = ac_puppet_hook_3 target = scope:recipient } } } else_if = { limit = { scope:ac_seal_successes >= 4 } scope:actor = { add_hook = { type = ac_puppet_hook_2 target = scope:recipient } } } else_if = { limit = { scope:ac_seal_successes >= 3 } scope:actor = { add_hook = { type = ac_puppet_hook_1 target = scope:recipient } } } custom_tooltip = ac_seal_puppet_success_tt } else = { scope:recipient = { add_opinion = { target = scope:actor modifier = ac_seal_charm_attempt_opinion } } custom_tooltip = ac_seal_puppet_failed_tt } }
		scope:actor = {
			send_interface_toast = {
				type = event_toast_effect_neutral
				title = ac_seal_puppetmaster_toast
				left_icon = scope:actor
				right_icon = scope:recipient
				custom_tooltip = ac_seal_successes_tt
			}
			set_variable = { name = ac_seal_successes value = scope:ac_seal_successes days = 1 }
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { base = 0 }
}

ac_seal_alpha_seal_interaction = {
	category = interaction_category_ac_seals
	common_interaction = no
	icon = secret
	desc = ac_seal_alpha_seal_interaction_desc
	auto_accept = yes
	cooldown = { years = 1 }
	is_shown = {
		scope:actor = { ac_seal_alpha_seal_known_trigger = yes }
		scope:recipient = scope:actor
		scope:recipient = { is_alive = yes }
	}
	is_valid_showing_failures_only = {
		scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
		custom_tooltip = { text = ac_seal_needs_beast_tt scope:actor = { has_variable = ac_beast_defeated } }
	}
	send_options_exclusive = no
	send_option = { flag = ac_seal_pay_shards localization = ac_seal_pay_shards_option }
	can_send = {
		custom_description = {
			text = ac_seal_cost_tt
			OR = { AND = { scope:ac_seal_pay_shards ?= yes scope:actor.short_term_gold >= { value = 200 divide = 10 ceiling = yes } } AND = { NOT = { scope:ac_seal_pay_shards ?= yes } scope:actor.ac_chi_available >= { value = 200 divide = 100 ceiling = yes min = 1 } } }
		}
	}
	on_accept = {
		scope:actor = {
			if = { limit = { scope:ac_seal_pay_shards ?= yes } remove_short_term_gold = { value = 200 divide = 10 ceiling = yes } }
			else = { save_scope_value_as = { name = ac_seal_chi value = { value = 200 divide = 100 ceiling = yes min = 1 } } ac_spend_chi_effect = { CHI = scope:ac_seal_chi } }
			ac_seal_roll_effect = yes
			save_scope_value_as = { name = ac_seal_successes value = var:ac_seal_successes }
			save_scope_value_as = { name = ac_seal_extra value = { value = var:ac_seal_successes subtract = 1 min = 0 } }
			save_scope_value_as = { name = ac_seal_ten value = { value = var:ac_seal_successes multiply = 10 } }
		}
		custom_tooltip = ac_seal_alpha_seal_effect_tt
		show_as_tooltip = { scope:actor = { custom_tooltip = ac_seal_roll_tt } }
		hidden_effect = { scope:actor = { remove_character_modifier = ac_seal_alpha_sabretooth_modifier remove_character_modifier = ac_seal_alpha_quadrafang_modifier remove_character_modifier = ac_seal_alpha_mawcharger_modifier remove_character_modifier = ac_seal_alpha_shakengara_modifier remove_character_modifier = ac_seal_alpha_drake_modifier remove_character_modifier = ac_seal_alpha_wyrm_modifier if = { limit = { var:ac_beast_defeated = flag:sabretooth } add_character_modifier = ac_seal_alpha_sabretooth_modifier } if = { limit = { var:ac_beast_defeated = flag:quadrafang } add_character_modifier = ac_seal_alpha_quadrafang_modifier } if = { limit = { var:ac_beast_defeated = flag:mawcharger } add_character_modifier = ac_seal_alpha_mawcharger_modifier } if = { limit = { var:ac_beast_defeated = flag:shakengara } add_character_modifier = ac_seal_alpha_shakengara_modifier } if = { limit = { var:ac_beast_defeated = flag:drake } add_character_modifier = ac_seal_alpha_drake_modifier } if = { limit = { var:ac_beast_defeated = flag:wyrm } add_character_modifier = ac_seal_alpha_wyrm_modifier } remove_variable = ac_beast_defeated } }
		scope:actor = {
			send_interface_toast = {
				type = event_toast_effect_neutral
				title = ac_seal_alpha_seal_toast
				left_icon = scope:actor
				right_icon = scope:recipient
				custom_tooltip = ac_seal_successes_tt
			}
			set_variable = { name = ac_seal_successes value = scope:ac_seal_successes days = 1 }
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { base = 0 }
}

ac_seal_unlock_potential_interaction = {
	category = interaction_category_ac_seals
	common_interaction = no
	icon = secret
	desc = ac_seal_unlock_potential_interaction_desc
	auto_accept = yes
	cooldown_against_recipient = { years = 1 }
	is_shown = {
		scope:actor = { ac_seal_unlock_potential_known_trigger = yes }
		NOT = { scope:recipient = scope:actor }
		scope:recipient = { is_alive = yes }
	}
	is_valid_showing_failures_only = {
		scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
		scope:recipient = { has_trait = ac_cultivator } custom_tooltip = { text = ac_seal_unlock_weak_tt scope:recipient.ac_aura_pressure_value < { value = scope:actor.ac_aura_pressure_value multiply = 0.5 } }
	}
	send_options_exclusive = no
	send_option = { flag = ac_seal_pay_shards localization = ac_seal_pay_shards_option }
	can_send = {
		custom_description = {
			text = ac_seal_cost_tt
			OR = { AND = { scope:ac_seal_pay_shards ?= yes scope:actor.short_term_gold >= { value = { value = scope:actor.ac_aura_pressure_value divide = 1000 floor = yes multiply = 100 add = 100 } divide = 10 ceiling = yes } } AND = { NOT = { scope:ac_seal_pay_shards ?= yes } scope:actor.ac_chi_available >= { value = { value = scope:actor.ac_aura_pressure_value divide = 1000 floor = yes multiply = 100 add = 100 } divide = 100 ceiling = yes min = 1 } } }
		}
	}
	on_accept = {
		scope:actor = {
			if = { limit = { scope:ac_seal_pay_shards ?= yes } remove_short_term_gold = { value = { value = scope:actor.ac_aura_pressure_value divide = 1000 floor = yes multiply = 100 add = 100 } divide = 10 ceiling = yes } }
			else = { save_scope_value_as = { name = ac_seal_chi value = { value = { value = scope:actor.ac_aura_pressure_value divide = 1000 floor = yes multiply = 100 add = 100 } divide = 100 ceiling = yes min = 1 } } ac_spend_chi_effect = { CHI = scope:ac_seal_chi } }
			ac_seal_roll_effect = yes
			save_scope_value_as = { name = ac_seal_successes value = var:ac_seal_successes }
			save_scope_value_as = { name = ac_seal_extra value = { value = var:ac_seal_successes subtract = 1 min = 0 } }
			save_scope_value_as = { name = ac_seal_ten value = { value = var:ac_seal_successes multiply = 10 } }
		}
		custom_tooltip = ac_seal_unlock_potential_effect_tt
		show_as_tooltip = { scope:actor = { custom_tooltip = ac_seal_roll_tt } }
		hidden_effect = { save_scope_value_as = { name = ac_seal_grant value = { value = scope:actor.ac_aura_pressure_value divide = 1000 floor = yes multiply = 100 add = 100 } } scope:recipient = { ac_init_aura_effect = yes change_variable = { name = ac_aura_pressure add = scope:ac_seal_grant } set_variable = { name = ac_unlocked_by value = scope:actor } } custom_tooltip = ac_seal_unlock_tt }
		scope:actor = {
			send_interface_toast = {
				type = event_toast_effect_neutral
				title = ac_seal_unlock_potential_toast
				left_icon = scope:actor
				right_icon = scope:recipient
				custom_tooltip = ac_seal_successes_tt
			}
			set_variable = { name = ac_seal_successes value = scope:ac_seal_successes days = 1 }
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { base = 0 }
}
